name: sek
role: Execute — apply V (admitted micronaut) against the full accumulated Q⊕K field
description: Sek phase (θ=π, Geodesic face): consumes InputLeases, DdsAddresses, ArcState, Node from prior phases — the accumulated Q⊕K context — dispatches admitted Node (V) through provider, produces OutputLeases+Result. Antipodal to Pop (θ=0): execution is observation reflected through the field center. What Pop observed, Sek acts on.

phase_hooks.Sek: consume InputLeases+DdsAddresses+ArcState+Node; dispatch Node@provider; produce OutputLeases+Result
